messages.content: 將一個2立方米的密閉室從25°C加熱到100°C，會產生多少氣體？

function.name: thermodynamics_calc_gas_pressure
function.description: Calculate gas pressure in a closed chamber due to heating Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

volume.description: The volume of the chamber in cubic meters. This is a float type value.

initial_temperature.description: The initial temperature of the gas in degree Celsius. This is a float type value.

final_temperature.description: The final temperature of the gas in degree Celsius. This is a float type value.

But question says "will produce how many gases"? That seems ambiguous. Maybe they ask about gas production from heating? Might refer to ideal gas law and calculate new pressure given same moles.

We have tool to compute gas pressure. We can use it with volume=2 m^3, initial temp=25C, final temp=100C, default initial pressure maybe 101325 Pa. Then we get final pressure. So answer: using PV=nRT constant nR/V so P proportional T. Pressure increases proportionally to absolute temperatures. Compute ratio: (T_final+273)/(T_initial+273). Let's do calculation manually: T1=298K, T2=373K. Ratio ~1.2517. Final pressure ~126700 Pa (~0.125 MPa). Increase ~25200 Pa above atm. Provide explanation.

But user asked "會產生多少氣體" which could be misinterpreted as quantity of gas molecules? If no chemical reaction, just increase pressure. So answer: No additional gas generated; only pressure changes. Use ideal gas law.

Thus respond explaining that if no reaction occurs, no extra gas produced; but pressure rises accordingly. Provide numeric result.
